articles.author: Anthony Faiola
articles.title: Pope Leo leans into statesman role, urging peace in an era of renewed war - The Washington Post
articles.description: Wrapping up a four-day trip to France, the pope praised the European Union for “tearing down walls.”
articles.content: METZ, France Pope Leo XIV capped a four-day trip to France in the intellectual birthplace of the European Union, heralding its success at tearing down walls that were dividing it and leaning into his… [+109 chars]
